{"CommandLine":"cat << 'EOF' > scratch.lean
import Mathlib
import LeanProject.GraphInvariantsComputable

open SimpleGraph

lemma mem_ballWithin_succ_of_adj {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (k : ℕ) (v u w : V) (hu : u ∈ GraphCalc.ballWithin G k v) (hadj : G.Adj u w) :
    w ∈ GraphCalc.ballWithin G (k + 1) v := by
  dsimp [GraphCalc.ballWithin]
  apply Finset.mem_union_right
  apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [Finset.mem_filter]
  exact ⟨Finset.mem_univ w, hadj⟩

lemma mem_ballWithin_of_walk_to {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (v : V) {w : V} (q : G.Walk w v) : w ∈ GraphCalc.ballWithin G q.length v := by
  generalize hlen : q.length = l
  induction l generalizing w q with
  | zero =>
    cases q with
    | nil =>
      dsimp [SimpleGraph.Walk.length, GraphCalc.ballWithin]
      exact Finset.mem_singleton_self v
    | cons h q' =>
      dsimp [SimpleGraph.Walk.length] at hlen
  | succ l' ih =>
    cases q with
    | nil =>
      dsimp [SimpleGraph.Walk.length] at hlen
    | cons hadj q' =>
      dsimp [SimpleGraph.Walk.length] at hlen
      injection hlen with hlen'
      have hq' : _ ∈ GraphCalc.ballWithin G l' v := ih q' hlen'
      subst hlen'
      exact mem_ballWithin_succ_of_adj G q'.length v _ _ hq' hadj.symm

lemma mem_ballWithin_of_walk {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {v w : V} (p : G.Walk v w) : w ∈ GraphCalc.ballWithin G p.length v := by
  have h := mem_ballWithin_of_walk_to G v p.reverse
  rw [SimpleGraph.Walk.length_reverse] at h
  exact h
